parsed.name: QX量子电路客户端
parsed.description: 一个非物理的软件客户端组件，用于通过网络连接 QX 量子电路服务，创建量子比特寄存器与量子电路、发送门操作命令、运行理想或含噪电路，并读取量子比特测量结果。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software client component for connecting to a QX quantum circuit service over the network, creating qubit registers and circuits, sending gate commands, running ideal or noisy circuits, and retrieving qubit measurement results.

actions.description: 连接到 QX 服务主机与端口。
actions.description_en: Connect to the QX service host and port.

actions.description: 创建指定名称的量子电路，并用给定门命令构建该电路。
actions.description_en: Create a named quantum circuit and build it from the provided gate commands.

actions.description: 创建指定数量的量子比特寄存器；如有需要会重置现有量子比特与电路。
actions.description_en: Create a qubit register with the requested number of qubits; existing qubits and circuits may be reset if needed.

actions.description: 断开与 QX 服务的连接。
列出当前已创建的量子电路。
actions.description_en: List the currently created quantum circuits.

actions.description: 移除所有量子比特和电路，并重置服务端状态。
actions.description_en: Remove all qubits and circuits and reset the server-side state.

actions.description: 运行指定名称的量子电路。
使用指定噪声模型、误差概率和迭代次数运行含噪量子电路。
actions.description_en: Run a noisy quantum circuit using the specified noise model, error probability, and iteration count.

actions.description: 向 QX 服务发送原始命令或批量门命令，并接收确认。
actions.description_en: Send a raw command or batched gate commands to the QX service and receive acknowledgement.

actions.description: 获取量子比特的测量结果。
获取量子比特的平均测量结果。
